How to Play

🎮
1. Choose your difficulty

Easy: 1–10 (5 guesses). Medium: 1–50 (7 guesses). Hard: 1–100 (7 guesses).

#
2. Guess the secret number

Enter a whole number and press Submit Guess.

↕
3. Follow the hints

Too High or Too Low helps you get closer!

🏆
4. Win before guesses run out!

Find the number, earn your trophy, and save your score.

✦ About Number Nova ✦

A Little Game, A Big Idea

Number Nova is a number-guessing adventure where every guess brings you closer to victory!

♥
Meet the Creator

Created by an 11-year-old girl who loves learning, coding, and turning imagination into something real.

🎮
What's Inside?

Three difficulty levels, helpful hints, trophies, avatars, sounds, and personal high scores!

💡
Why I Made This

I wanted to learn how games work and create something people everywhere could enjoy.

🚀
My Message to Other Kids

You don't have to be a grown-up to start creating. Be curious, keep learning, and try your ideas!

Version 1.0 · Creator description to be approved by a parent before publishing.
